description: Main source file for a middleware component that interacts with the Machines library, performing file reading, spec provisioning, and machine management operations including processing messages, managing crews, and handling emitted messages.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a dynamically allocated buffer.

methods.name: specProvider
methods.description: Provides a JSON spec file by appending '.js' to the spec name and reading it.

methods.name: checkrc
methods.description: Checks the return code and exits if it indicates an error.

methods.name: rcprintf
methods.description: Prints a formatted message and checks the return code.

methods.name: printer
methods.description: Prints a JSON string to stdout.
